model: Daintree DCS sensor zone device (BACnet IP)
equipment_type: Occupancy and light sensor zone (virtual device)
applies_to: Each sensor-only zone configured in Daintree Controls Software, exposed as a virtual BACnet device behind its WAC.
summary: Sensor zones in DCS hold only switches and sensors. Each one appears as a read-only virtual BACnet IP device that reports people count, ambient light, temperature, occupancy and a zone fault code. Only the points backed by a mapped sensor are created; Fault is always there.
default_device_instance: Set in DCS (start/end virtual zone device ID range)
notes: Points exist only when the matching wireless sensor is mapped to the zone (e.g. an occupancy-only zone shows just Occupied, plus Fault).
All points support COV; device name is the zone name from DCS.

source.title: Daintree Controls Software (DCS) BACnet integration guide

integration.summary: Enable BACnet on the WAC in DCS, then read the sensor zone devices for occupancy, people count, light and temperature. Nothing on these devices is writable.

minimum_points.name: People Count
minimum_points.why: People count, sum of zone counters

minimum_points.name: Fault
minimum_points.why: Zone fault: 1 normal, 2 comm failure, 3 bad config

setup: Set in DCS (Configure > Gateway > BACnet settings): router device ID, network number, virtual network number, start/end virtual zone device IDs, NIC (wan or building), port (normally 47808).
Foreign device registration to a BBMD is available when the WAC is not on the BMS LAN.
The WAC routes BACnet IP to a virtual network; each zone is its own virtual device (B-ASC profile).
gotchas: Expect missing objects on zones without the matching sensor type.

points.name: People Count
points.description: Sum of all people counters in the zone

points.name: Ambient Light Level
points.description: Average of the zone's photo sensors

points.name: Temperature
points.description: Average of the zone's temperature sensors

points.name: Fault
points.states: 1=Normal operation, 2=Communication failure with associated device, 3=Invalid configuration

points.name: Occupied
points.description: Occupied if any zone occupancy sensor reports occupied
